title: Studio's draft panel and commit timeline address a bundle member: read `member` off `_drafts` / package commits and pass `?member=` (the objectui half of objectstack#23073)
body:
Filing gate **④** (a coordination node): the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23073, filed by the claiming seat at claim, as triage asked ("Studio's use of it is objectui's, filed at claim", `6129686435`). Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are this repository's triage.

**Who acts:** the objectui seat that owns `@object-ui/app-shell`'s Studio preview, once the spec release carrying the new response key reaches this repository.

## Why

- Ruling `6116165299` (letter A, on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22877) made each member of a bundle addressable by name. Today that means one language of an `email_template`, through `?member=` on the by-name `/meta` doors (landed as objectstack `038d4c958`).
- The two LIST doors do not yet say which member an entry is. Two languages of one `email_template` read from `GET /meta/_drafts` and `GET /packages/:id/commits` as two entries with the same `type` and `name`.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#23073 adds `member` to those entries for a discriminated type.

## The renderer work (objectui `origin/main`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx` reads `_drafts` (around L99–140). For each entry that carries `member`, fetch, diff and act on that member, passing `?member=` on the by-name doors. Do not use the canonical body for both entries.
- `packages/app-shell/src/preview/CommitTimeline.tsx` reads package commits. Show the member where an item carries one.
- The exact key and its presence rule ("only for a discriminated type") land with the objectstack PR. Read them from the spec at the version that carries them.

## Order

This waits on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23073's PR (dispatched now), then on a spec release this repository can install.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, for `DraftChangesPanel member bundle email template language draft list commits member query parameter`: 0 hits.
